sources: https://parksandrec8.wixsite.com/menomineerecreation/campground (the Menominee Recreation Department site the City of Menominee's own site menominee.us links to, checked 2026-10-22)

values.note: City of Menominee 'Current Rates' sheet (dated May 2025), one rate for everyone: standard full hook-up $40 a night ($240/week, $840/month), prime full hook-up $45 ($270/week, $945/month); power-only sites 55-58; pop-up or truck camper $30; tent $25 (3-night max). Visitors $5 per person per day, overnight guests $5 per person per night. Cash or check only - no cards. $20 cancellation fee; early check-in $10.

fees.source: https://15a6a5c7-8947-42ee-bfa2-2182aee824b3.filesusr.com/ugd/bb7143_1727ae3787a040f585ccb231fcf990fc.pdf ('Prime Full Hook-up: $45/night', 'Standard Full Hook-up: $40/night') + Guidelines and Policies PDF, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://parksandrec8.wixsite.com/menomineerecreation/campground ('The majority of the sites are full hook-up (City water, sewer and electricity) with 20/30 amp. electrical service'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://parksandrec8.wixsite.com/menomineerecreation/campground ('River Park Campground features 58 paved sites'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: Guidelines and Policies PDF ('Shower facility $5.00 per person/per day, if not a registered camper'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Opens May 15; the park phone is staffed May-October.

season.source: https://parksandrec8.wixsite.com/menomineerecreation/campground ('River Park Campground IS SCHEDULED TO OPEN MAY 15') + rates sheet ('RIVER PARK PHONE (906) 863-5101 MAY ~ OCTOBER'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Request a site with the online submission form, the printable form (mail or email), or by email to riverparkcampground@menomineemi.gov; a request is not confirmed until staff call back. Reservations recommended. Deposit required (one night paid in full). Off-season phone (906) 863-1737 (January-May). Check-in from 1 p.m. Central.

booking.source: https://parksandrec8.wixsite.com/menomineerecreation/campground ('To request a reservation online, simply click on our Online Submission Form', 'Requests are not confirmed until a member of our staff contacts you', 'Reservations recommended') + Reservation Request Form PDF ('Off Season Phone: (906) 863-1737 (January-May)') + Guidelines and Policies PDF, read 2026-10-22

note: City of Menominee park on the Menominee River (downtown, behind Jack's Fresh Market); paved sites, boat launch, fishing decks, pavilion. RV groups welcome. NOTE: distinct from Menominee County's River Park (4 primitive sites in Wallace) - this is the city's 58-site downtown park. --Claude
summary: City recreation department's Wix site (linked from menominee.us, so current) and its 2025 rate sheet and policies confirm $40 standard / $45 prime full hook-up (no resident split; cash/check only), 58 paved sites, full hookups with 20/30-amp, showers, opens May 15 (phone staffed May-Oct), reservations by request form/email/phone. Phone (906) 863-5101 matches. The note's '$10 reservation fee' is not on the city's pages (only a $20 cancellation and $10 early check-in fee) - dropped with the other field text.
flags: Website: the second link is a MARVAC member directory listing (https://www.michiganrvandcampgrounds.org/member-info/city-of-menominee-river-park-campground/); strip it. The Wix page is the city's current one (menominee.us links it).
